definition.D2max: Sum d(P) over120 pairs; each d(P) is the maximum of its91 explicit row deficits.
definition.not_equal_to: The sum of deficits over all10920 rows is a separate metric and is generally larger.
definition.top_two: Two distinct triple positions from all14 x outside P; equal count values allowed; zero positions retained.
definition.zero_equivalence: D2max=0 iff every one of10920 pair-two-triple inequalities is satisfied.

incremental_scope.affected_pairs: Union of all pairs in removed/added blocks, including pairs with zero net count change; at most20.
incremental_scope.auxiliaries: No quad count cache needed for the proposed energy; D3,D4 and explicit stronger-row sum are independently recounted at audits and records.
incremental_scope.completeness: Every changed triple lies in an old or new block, and every row containing that triple has its pair in the union.
incremental_scope.work: Recompute top-two values from14 triple positions per affected pair; at most280 position inspections.

proposed_acceptance.local_priority_proof: A single old-to-new block replacement changes uncovered count by at most10; thus20 exceeds the maximum hole swing, making a D2 decrease strictly downhill regardless of H. This does not make weighted energy globally lexicographic; record keys are lexicographic separately.
proposed_acceptance.phase_A_restart: Every third restart original assigned hint, otherwise best lexicographic state; first equal key retained.
proposed_acceptance.profile: Recount and report global profile on all saved states. Qualification target is exact zeroD2 with four caps; no unapproved extra profile penalty or guard.
proposed_acceptance.stop: Stop immediately at first fully recounted D2max=0. Use qualified_hint_found if H>0; cover_found status if H=0 is only a candidate until both verifiers confirm.
